name: eager-start
why: initial_suspend does not suspend: the body runs to its first co_yield when the generator is created.

edits.old: std::suspend_always initial_suspend() noexcept { return {}; }  // lazy: nothing runs until the first next()

name: frame-destroyed-at-the-end
why: final_suspend does not suspend: the frame is destroyed by the coroutine itself, and the Generator's handle dangles.

edits.old: std::suspend_always final_suspend() noexcept { return {}; }    // stay suspended at the end: the Generator destroys the frame

name: yield-does-not-suspend
why: co_yield does not stop the coroutine: it runs on to the end at the first next().

edits.old: return {};  // suspend: control goes back to whoever resumed us

name: the-frame-is-never-destroyed
why: the destructor forgets handle_.destroy(): every abandoned generator leaks its frame.

name: move-copies-the-handle
why: the moved-from generator keeps the handle: the frame is destroyed twice.

name: move-assignment-leaks-the-old-frame
why: the frame that the target owned is not destroyed before it takes the new one.

name: next-resumes-a-finished-coroutine
why: no done() check: asking again after the end resumes a coroutine that has finished (undefined behavior).

name: begin-does-not-start
why: the iterator starts at the end without asking for a first value.

name: range-includes-the-end
why: off by one: end is yielded too.

edits.old: for (int i = begin; i < end; ++i) co_yield i;
edits.new: for (int i = begin; i <= end; ++i) co_yield i;

edits.old:
unsigned long long a = 0;
    unsigned long long b = 1;
edits.new:
unsigned long long a = 1;
    unsigned long long b = 1;

name: take-asks-one-value-too-many
why: the count is checked at the start of the loop body: the source is asked for an extra value.

name: words-keeps-empty-words
why: every space ends a word, so several spaces give empty words.

edits.new:
const std::size_t start = pos;
        const std::size_t end = text.find(' ', start);

edits.old:
co_yield text.substr(start, end - start);
        pos = end;
edits.new:
co_yield text.substr(start, end - start);
        pos = end + 1;

name: words-takes-a-reference
why: a reference parameter: the frame refers to the caller's string, which can be gone (Clean tier).

why: not a coroutine at all: it returns an empty generator, so there is nothing to iterate.
